name: Subscription Publication
tagline: A paywalled publication: each signed-in page view also reads the reader.
realWorld: Free and paid articles behind a server-side paywall. A signed-in reader's page costs one read of their member record on top of the article, because access is decided from the tier and status the payment provider last reported.

traffic.desc: an article page resolves its slug, since there is no get-by-slug route
the layout reads the signed-in reader on every page to decide access
the account page's license panel, an engine route that no plugin serves
the member list the signed-out account page shows, because the demo has no sign-up

_note: Load-test manifest for this example. The content types are NOT listed here: perf/export-profiles.mjs reads them from the running engine so they cannot drift from the app. This file declares only what the app itself does not: benchmark-scale seed volumes, the arrival rate, the thresholds, and the weighted request mix. The weights assume article pages 60, front page 35 and account page 5 per hundred page views, with 40 of every hundred views from a signed-in reader. Every reader is seeded as an active member and every article as paid, so each reader read is the one that unlocks an article. Three calls are left out. Sign-in looks a member up with filters[email], and the driver can sample an id or a slug but not a field value, so the lookup would either miss or match every seeded reader. The payment provider's webhook reads the member on the admin router and writes it back with a PUT, which the driver cannot send. Media downloads need uploaded files, which the seeder does not create.
